review.initialFinding: Root privacy drift during fsync could escape scratch-root admission.
review.resolution: Final descriptor and visible root ownership/private-mode checks added; regression reproduces and refuses drift without changing permissions.
review.result: Independent source review clear after fix.

invariants: Descriptor-relative no-follow creation and bottom-up ancestor fsync before factory admission.
State root published before lease registration; scratch root published under that lease before engine admission.
Lock file/root entry synced before registering ownership; failed sync retains files but grants no owner.
No permission repair, deletion, service activation or NAS operation.
